title: ARCHIVE TRAINING // HEX & ASCII
content:
ARCHIVE TRAINING

DATA INTERPRETATION // MODULE 01

Some recovered data is stored as hexadecimal bytes rather than readable text.
Before interpreting corrupted archive material, learn how hexadecimal values can represent ASCII characters.

TRAINING VIDEO:
HEX to ASCII
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mQC0heJ5XrM

TRAINING NOTE #01
Two hexadecimal symbols can represent one byte.
Do not assume that a sequence of numbers is meaningless.

OBJECTIVE:
Learn the conversion method, then return to the corrupted archive file.
